patch_description:
This crossover keeps the higher-scoring current program’s neutral wall-adjacency priority (`0`) while retaining the strip enclosure strategy from both parents.

The main internal improvement is reachability-aware wall selection. The original programs rank candidate build standing squares using Manhattan distance, even when walls have made that square unreachable. This can make humans repeatedly select inaccessible targets and waste turns. The rewritten version performs one BFS distance search per active human and only considers reachable standing squares, using actual path distance for ranking. It also uses a compact fixed-array BFS implementation and boolean occupancy maps for planned walls and move destinations.

The interaction protocol, 300-turn behavior, action format, flushing, and pet-movement state updates are preserved.
